proof_body:
by
  intro f c R n hR hf
  have h := hf.circleIntegral_one_div_sub_center_pow_smul hR n
  have e : (∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)) = ∮ z in C(c, R), (1 / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)) • f z := by
    congr 1; funext z; simp [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  rw [e, h]
  have h2 : (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0 := Complex.two_pi_I_ne_zero
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast n.factorial_ne_zero
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < R → DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Metric.ball c R) → iteratedDeriv n f c = ((n.factorial : ℂ) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I)) * ∮ z in C(c, R), f z / (z - c) ^ (n + 1)
